q1_issues.issue: (Member identification easy) puts a bare class symbol in the individual slot; a class / property subject takes Inheritance, so the atom predicates easiness of identification-in-general through the individual relation.

q2_gaps: A gerundive (-ing) complement of a mental verb ("consider using X"): the instruction set routes finite that-clauses to sealing, perception verbs' bare-infinitive/participial complements to Stimulus, and causative complements to Theme, but says nothing about consider / avoid / suggest plus gerund.

A bare-plural indefinite object carrying a descriptive modifier ("clear containers", "leftovers"): the bare class symbol has nowhere to hold the modifier, and the singular witness the parse mints loses plurality, with no third form given.
notes: The definite "the fridge" correctly projects its typing atom outside the Directive seal while the indefinite witnesses stay inside, no addressee referent is minted, and the purpose infinitive takes the To head with the main action first.
